definitions: To continue to operate or function with very little energy, resources, or strength remaining.
To be extremely tired or exhausted but still continuing to work or function.
examples: After working three overnight shifts, I'm running on fumes.
The project team is running on fumes, but they're determined to finish on time.
My car is running on fumes; I need to find a gas station soon.
synonyms: at the end of one's rope
burning the candle at both ends
